name: MPLoader Product Ad Publisher for WooCommerce
author: mploader

sections.description:
MPLoader Product Ad Publisher for WooCommerce connects your WooCommerce store to classified advertisement publishing through the Goedgeplaatst API.

The plugin helps you manually create advertisements from WooCommerce products using existing product data such as title, description, price and images.

The plugin is focused on manual publishing. You choose a WooCommerce product, select the correct Goedgeplaatst category and publish the advertisement from your WordPress admin.

MPLoader Product Ad Publisher does not use scraping, browser automation, bots or unofficial methods. The connection runs through the Goedgeplaatst API and requires your own Goedgeplaatst account and API key.

Features

  • Manually publish WooCommerce products as advertisements
  • Select a Goedgeplaatst category per product
  • Use product title, short WooCommerce description, price and images
  • Choose draft or live publishing, depending on your configuration
  • Remove advertisements created through the plugin
  • Works with your own Goedgeplaatst account and API key
  • No scraping, bots or browser automation

Requirements

  • WordPress
  • WooCommerce
  • A Goedgeplaatst account with an API key

Important notice

MPLoader Product Ad Publisher for WooCommerce is an independent plugin. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, officially supported by, partnered with or contractually related to Goedgeplaatst, Marktplaats B.V. or eBay.

Goedgeplaatst and Marktplaats are trademarks of their respective owners.

External services

This plugin connects to an external service in order to create, publish and remove advertisements.

Goedgeplaatst API

Service domain: api.goedgeplaatst.nl

The plugin connects to the Goedgeplaatst API when you manually create, publish or remove an advertisement from WooCommerce. The plugin may also connect to the Goedgeplaatst API from the settings page to retrieve category or seller/manufacturer information needed for configuration.

Data sent to Goedgeplaatst may include:

  • Your Goedgeplaatst API key
  • WooCommerce product title
  • WooCommerce short product description
  • Product price
  • Product image URLs
  • Selected Goedgeplaatst category
  • Product URL
  • Location data entered in the plugin settings, such as city and postal code
  • Goedgeplaatst user and seller/manufacturer identifiers configured in the plugin

This connection is required for the main plugin functionality. Data is sent when you manually publish, manage, remove or configure advertisements through the plugin.

Terms: https://goedgeplaatst.nl/gebruiksvoorwaarden
Privacy policy: https://goedgeplaatst.nl/privacy-statement
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/mploader-ad-publisher directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Create or use your own Goedgeplaatst account and API key.
  5. Go to the MPLoader settings page in your WordPress admin.
  6. Enter your Goedgeplaatst API key and required advertisement settings.
  7. Open a WooCommerce product, select the correct Goedgeplaatst category and publish your advertisement.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Goedgeplaatst account?

Yes. The plugin uses the Goedgeplaatst API to create and manage advertisements. You need your own Goedgeplaatst account and API key.

Is the plugin free?

Yes. Manual publishing is available in this plugin.

Does the plugin use scraping?

No. The plugin does not use scraping, browser automation, bots or unofficial methods. It uses the Goedgeplaatst API.

Is this an official Goedgeplaatst or Marktplaats plugin?

No. MPLoader Product Ad Publisher for WooCommerce is an independent plugin. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, officially supported by, partnered with or contractually related to Goedgeplaatst, Marktplaats B.V. or eBay.

Can I remove advertisements created through the plugin?

Yes. When an advertisement has been created through the plugin, you can remove it from the WooCommerce product screen, depending on your configuration and available API actions.

Can I choose between draft and live publishing?

Yes. The plugin includes settings that let you choose whether advertisements are created as draft advertisements or published live, depending on your Goedgeplaatst configuration.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Free edition now uses only the WooCommerce short description for advertisements.
  • Removed the long/short description selector from the Free settings.
  • Added a clear validation message when a product has no short description.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Manual WooCommerce product publishing via Goedgeplaatst.
  • Category selection per product.
  • Product title, description, price and image support.
  • Draft or live publishing mode.
  • Advertisement removal support.
